description: Roadmap: higher-level capabilities and milestones, not tasks. Task and architecture detail is handed to other agents.

id.description: stable id, prefix + slug; never reused

tldr.description: optional: one short paragraph. The central concept and the tension: what pulls different ways, what is at stake or undecided

source.description: where this came from, e.g. session date or message id

mvp.description: true if it is part of the landing the other apps depend on

outcome.description: what is true when this is done

tasks.description: Torque task ids; tasks stay in Torque, this is a pointer

rev.description: write counter, starts at 1, incremented by the service on every write; missing counts as 0

order.description: list order within the database; items without it sort after those with it

author.description: who created the item (set by the service on create)

related_ids.description: generic link to item ids in any database
